findings.body: The previously reported P2 remains: this validator rejects total=0. The producer in src/forge/review.py:301–305 accepts zero-item pytest collection, and lines 311–332 accept and publish a zero TAP plan. Consequently, legitimate {done: 0, total: 0} progress rejects the entire Machine refresh and prevents confirmed stops. Accept zero totals and display elapsed time without a progress bar, guarding label() against division by zero.
findings.title: Accept zero-test progress without rejecting the entire snapshot

findings.body: The previously reported P2 remains: if the run finishes after the fresh lanes read but before stop executes, src/forge/machine.py:286–287 returns zero with "There is nothing to stop." This line discards that response and incorrectly displays "Run stopped." Preserve the no-target outcome and display the ended/replaced message with its next action. The existing stale-target tests remove the entry before the fresh lanes read, so they do not catch this race.
findings.title: Preserve the stop command's no-target outcome

stop.reason: Owner accepts: the spinner's place-in-line ships as a separate small fix next; the extra drawing-test coverage is dismissed per the one-test-per-rule direction.
